articles.summary: Third quarter 2025 total revenue was $10.5 million, up 9% from prior year Achieves five consecutive quarters of year-over-year revenue growth Company reaffirms 2025 revenue guidance of $39-42 million HOLLISTER, Calif., Nov. 06, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alpha Teknova, Inc.
articles.title: Teknova Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results
